_comment: Valopeilit (games/peilit): the same ids as voice/fi.json.

clips.peilit_tip1: Circle the mirror with your finger to turn it. Guide the light to the flower.
clips.peilit_tip2: Put a mirror in the light. The cat wants a nap in the sun.
clips.peilit_tip3: Two mirrors take the light around the stone to the sunflower.
clips.peilit_tip4: A mirror can be turned at a slant. Bring the light to the solar panel.
clips.peilit_tip5: A half mirror splits the light in two. Light up both flowers.
clips.peilit_tip6: The owl sleeps in the day. Don't wake it! Warm up the lizard.
clips.peilit_tip7: Bolted mirrors don't turn. Light the cat and dry the laundry.
clips.peilit_tip8: Two lights. Each one needs its own path.
clips.peilit_tip9: Light crosses the water, but no mirror can stand in it.
clips.peilit_tip10: Two half mirrors and three flowers.
clips.peilit_tip11: Many owls. Find a safe path.
clips.peilit_tip12: Everyone wants light, except the owl.
